title: The WORST Smell
text: The WORST Smell. The smell just does not go away.  The worst.  After a week, still smelled Bad.  Had to air out my bed room to get the smell out.  Beware!

product_metadata.title: Linenspa 4 Inch- Full – Machine Washable – Breathable – Non Slip – Cover for Mattress Topper with Zipper – Topper Cover Only, White
features: SLEEP PROTECTED: Keep your mattress topper safe and protected! Mattress topper covers help extend your mattress topper’s life while maintaining its quality
FIND THE PERFECT FIT: Multiple sizes and profiles available! Choose from 2, 3, and 4 inch mattress topper cover profiles to make sure you get the right fit for your topper
BREATHABLE COMFORT: Polyester-blend fabric cover is soft, noiseless, and breathable, so you can sleep comfortably. The best part? Your mattress topper cover is stain-resistant
EASY TO PUT ON: No need to stress over set up! Mattress topper cover features a zipper enclosure that makes it easy to put on, take off, and toss in the wash
EASY TO CLEAN: Our easy-to-clean mattress topper cover with zipper is machine washable and dryer safe, so clean up and laundry day stay stress free
description: Extend the life of your memory foam mattress topper with this soft and cozy Linenspa Mattress Topper Cover. This zippered mattress topper cover comes with a non-slip rubberized bottom surface that helps it sit securely on your mattress. And the handy zipper opening makes it easy to put on your topper—as well as take off when it’s time to machine wash and dry. The polyester-blend fabric is soft, quiet, and breathable, meaning your mattress topper stays comfortable. And the best part? It’s stain-resistant, so your mattress topper cover with zipper is a great way to protect your mattress topper. Why get a cover? Mattress topper covers help extend the life and maintain the quality of your mattress topper. You’ll love your new Linenspa Mattress Topper Cover. Does not include mattress topper. Cover only.
